resources.string: A little more space for yourself
Pay with SBP for one calendar month. Renew manually when you choose. No automatic charges.
Write and browse your diary without advertising.
Local statistics about writing, moods and tags. Calculated entirely on your phone.
Entries, offline search, encryption, export and backups stay free. Your diary remains available when Pro expires.
Internet is needed only for ads and payment actions. Payment sends a random installation ID and a recovery code, never diary content.
Payments are not configured in this build. Your diary works offline as usual.
After paying, return here and tap Check payment. Access is enabled only after secure confirmation.
Enter the recovery code saved on your previous phone. Restore needs an internet connection and does not transfer diary entries.
Keep this code in a safe place. It restores paid access after reinstalling or changing phones. Anyone with the code can use it. It does not back up your diary.
